name: Menu item
summary: A restaurant dish as a sheet: a photo, description, a required choice, optional extras with prices and a limit, a note for the kitchen, quantity and an Add button with the live total.
use: when someone taps a dish on a restaurant or café menu
a11y: The base and extras are native radio and checkbox groups whose whole row is the label; extras past the limit are disabled, the note has a label, the count is announced, and the Add button carries the live total.
